source: describe_dataset detail=True; variable list verified identical to the MODIS AER_DBDT siblings 2026-08-02 (VIIRS/SNPP)

variables.name: DT_Number_Of_Pixels
variables.long_name: Number of samples for Aerosol Optical Depth (AOD) at 0.55 micron for both ocean (Average) (Quality flag = 1, 2, 3) and land (corrected) (Quality flag = 3), for the grid

variables.name: DT_AOD_550_AVG
variables.long_name: Aerosol Optical Depth (AOD) at 0.55 micron for both ocean (Average) (Quality flag = 1, 2, 3) and land (corrected) (Quality flag = 3), mean for the grid

variables.name: DT_AOD_550_STD
variables.long_name: Aerosol Optical Depth (AOD) at 0.55 micron for both ocean (Average) (Quality flag = 1, 2, 3) and land (corrected) (Quality flag = 3), standard deviation for the grid

variables.name: DB_Number_Of_Pixels
variables.long_name: Number of samples for Deep Blue/SOAR Aerosol Optical Depth (AOD) at 550 nm over land and ocean, QA-filtered, for the grids

variables.name: DB_AOD_550_AVG
variables.long_name: Deep Blue/SOAR Aerosol Optical Depth (AOD) at 550 nm over land and ocean, QA-filtered, mean for the grid

variables.name: DB_AOD_550_STD
variables.long_name: Deep Blue/SOAR Aerosol Optical Depth (AOD) at 550 nm over land and ocean, QA-filtered, standard deviation for the grid

variables.name: DT_DB_AOD_550_AVG
variables.long_name: Aerosol Optical Depth (AOD) at 550 nm, derived using DT as preferred source, falling back to DB if DT is invalid. Values are averaged over the grid.

variables.name: DB_DT_AOD_550_AVG
variables.long_name: Aerosol Optical Depth (AOD) at 550 nm, derived using DB as preferred source, falling back to DT if DB is invalid. Values are averaged over the grid.

variables.name: COMBINE_AOD_550_AVG
variables.long_name: Aerosol Optical Depth (AOD) at 550 nm, combined average from DT and DB sources. Values are averaged over the grid, using valid values from both DT and DB.

variables.name: Sensor_Zenith_Angle
variables.long_name: TERRA MODIS Sensor Viewing Angle, mean for the grid
